witness.candidate_quote: Whenever a vehicle is parked or stopped upon the traveled portion of a highway or shoulder adjacent thereto
witness.quote: Whenever a vehicle is parked or stopped upon the traveled portion of a highway or shoulder adjacent thereto, whether attended or unattended during the times mentioned in NRS 484D.100 [NRS-484D-100-1], and there is insufficient light to reveal any person or object within a distance of 1,000 feet upon such highway or roadway, such vehicle shall display lighted lamps meeting the requirements of subsection 1 [(1) appended below]. Every vehicle shall be equipped with one or more lamps which, when lighted, shall display a white or amber light visible from a distance of 500 feet to the front of the vehicle, and one or more lamps which, when lighted, shall display a red light visible from a distance of 500 feet to the rear of the vehicle. The location of such lamps shall be such that at least one such lamp is installed as near as practicable to the side of the vehicle which is closest to passing traffic.
witness.reason: Curbside parking can place a qualifying vehicle on the traveled portion or adjacent shoulder; the lighting and referenced-time conditions remain conditional.
required_context: Realize curb geometry, parking approach and target, traffic direction, and vehicle and load dimensions.
Establish qualifying vehicle classification, highway dedication and public vehicular use, and placement relative to traveled-portion and shoulder boundaries.
Establish parking activity and any actual loading or unloading; record attendance without restricting the express unattended scope.
Retain the unresolved NRS 484D.100 timing condition.

Obtain physical evidence concerning revelation of persons or objects within 1,000 feet, lamp visibility from 500 feet front and rear, lamp colors and operating states, and installation relative to passing traffic.
witness.review_method: Agent review of exact law, fixed layout/maneuver/control, actor scope and retained conditional context

targeted_requirements.quote: such vehicle shall display lighted lamps meeting the requirements of subsection 1
targeted_requirements.rationale: Capture the parked interval and all appended equipment properties without treating lamp activation alone as evidence of visibility.
